title: How to make custom clothing - Cheap eBay vinyl cutter and heat press
description: Expand your making horizons! In part two of this series on what a cheap eBay vinyl can do, we explore the use of the cutter with heat transfer vinyl to create custom t-shirts, hats and even mugs.  This guide to the entire process includes preparation, cutting, weeding and heat transfer.  Refine MH721 eBay Aus: https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/NEW-JET-BLACK-REFINE-MH721-VINYL-CUTTER-PLOTTER-SIGN-WRITING-MACHINE/372158900688?hash=item56a66629d0:g:1VQAAOSws4JW8Kxc USCutter equivalent on Amazon: https://amzn.to/2LNnFVi  Heat transfer vinyl I used (Aus): https://www.bizsupplies.com.au/shirt-printing/heat-transfer-vinyl.html Equivalent vinyl on Amazon: https://amzn.to/2Az3bdt  Heat press 5in1 eBay Aus: https://www.ebay.com.au/itm/5IN-1-SWING-Heat-Press-Machine-Sublimation-Transfer-Cap-Plate-Mug-T-shirt-Print/112538436235?hash=item1a33d0428b:g:sQkAAOSw~vNavaVp An equivalent machine on Amazon: https://amzn.to/2MfmFFo  Easy Cut Studio software: http://www.easycutstudio.com/  Buy quality and affordable filament from X3D. Buy 3, get 1 free and a free sample pack with every order: www.x3d.com.au  Gearbest affiliate link (help support the channel): https://www.gearbest.com/?lkid=13807527  Take a look around and if you like what you see, please subscribe.
